task: show me how to change the cursor type

evidence.description: Brand Kit → Screen Clips page open with the Cursor Style dropdown expanded showing the three cursor type choices

summary:
Here's how to change the cursor type (cursor style) in Yarn, at the brand-wide default scope:
1. In the left sidebar, click **Brand Kit** (bottom).
2. In the Brand Kit nav, select **Screen Clips** — the page titled "Screen Clip Settings" opens.
3. Under the **Cursor** section, click the **Cursor Style** dropdown (currently "Pointer-first"). It is now open showing the three options: **Arrow-first**, **Pointer-first**, **Original** — click the one you want and it applies immediately.

I navigated there and opened the dropdown to show the choices, but did NOT change the value (still Pointer-first). Note: this is the brand default (Default Brand). To change it for a single project only, open that project → **Project actions ⋯** → **Screen Clip Settings…** → Cursor Style → **Done**; that's a separate store from the brand default.
